events.title: Repsol’s Earnings Rise as Traders Get Boost From Iran Conflict
events.body: Spain’s Repsol posted a jump in first-quarter profit as its refineries and traders capitalized on disruption to global energy markets triggered by conflict in the Middle East.

events.title: Eni Moves to Relaunch Venezuela Heavy Oil Project
events.body: Eni has signed an agreement with Venezuela’s Hydrocarbons Ministry and PDVSA to relaunch oil activity at the Junin-5 heavy oil project while advancing gas development at the Perla field.
